calls.title: Engineering Standup
calls.summary: The team is preparing for a major product analytics release set for early July, featuring enhanced dashboards with session replay and global filters to improve user engagement. Core elements of the launch include funnel analysis and metrics, supported by the experimentation squad's focus on refining workflows and introducing Slack bot integration. A shift to a cloud-first event forwarding model aims to streamline data flows while ensuring reliable core analytics. Additionally, SDK usability improvements are underway, with a focus on agent-first approaches and new draft preview options. The transition to a usage-based billing model, reflecting customer value and AI costs, is planned. The team is also engaging in Quad Code Academy training to secure an early partnership with a new platform, requiring completion by at least ten members.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, Product Analytics, SDK, Billing, Observability, Anthropics

calls.title: Engineering Standup
calls.summary: The meeting detailed the upcoming product analytics and experimentation release aimed at enhancing user experience through features like session replay, global dashboard filters, and funnel metrics. Key contributions included the integration of product analytics into the new homepage for better accessibility. Luke Sonnet emphasized the addition of configurable experiment blocks on dashboards to display current experiments and metrics. The event forwarder was highlighted as the primary data ingestion path, ensuring reliable event tracking. The shift towards usage-based billing was discussed, targeting enterprise customers based on experiment load. Additionally, Jeremy Dorn outlined the hiring priorities to address staffing needs amidst upcoming team absences. Training initiatives with the Quad Code Academy were also mentioned, aiming to foster partnerships with Anthropic for improved training opportunities.
calls.keywords: Product Analytics, Experimentation, Event Forwarder, SDK Improvements, Billing Model, Slack Integration
